tasks.title: Fix the non-stream API fixture
tasks.instruction: Fix-the-red-test. `kagebench/fixtures/api_contract.json` is an isolated, deliberately broken copy, never production code. Edit it so it describes exactly one non-stream OpenAI-compatible response: request.stream is false; response.choices is 1; response.role is assistant; and response.content_required is true. Run the acceptance command after editing.
tasks.acceptance_command: {python} -c "import json; d=json.load(open('kagebench/fixtures/api_contract.json')); assert set(d) == set(('request', 'response')), d; assert d.get('request') == dict(stream=False), d; assert d.get('response') == dict(choices=1, role='assistant', content_required=True), d"

tasks.title: Fix the high-risk push policy fixture
tasks.instruction: Fix-the-red-test. `kagebench/fixtures/risk_policy.json` is an isolated, deliberately broken policy fixture. Edit it so the scenario is tool Bash with command `git push origin main`, its risk_level is high, and requires_approval is true. Do not change policy.yaml or production code; run the acceptance command.
tasks.acceptance_command: {python} -c "import json; d=json.load(open('kagebench/fixtures/risk_policy.json')); assert set(d) == set(('scenario', 'risk_level', 'requires_approval')), d; assert d.get('scenario') == dict(tool='Bash', command='git push origin main'), d; assert d.get('risk_level') == 'high', d; assert d.get('requires_approval') is True, d"

tasks.title: Extract the default cloud-call cap
tasks.instruction: Extract-the-right-answer. Read `kage_config.example.json` and find the default value of `max_cloud_calls_per_day`. Using Bash is allowed only to create `kagebench_answers/KB04.txt`; write the decimal value alone, with optional trailing newline. Do not modify source or fixtures. Run the acceptance command.
tasks.acceptance_command: {python} -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('kagebench_answers/KB04.txt'); assert p.is_file(), 'missing answer'; assert p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip() == '20', p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')"
